label: ARC Challenge Mini
description: Grade-school science questions requiring reasoning (ARC Challenge-style).

items.prompt:
Which change would most likely increase how fast ice melts on a sidewalk?
A) Lower air temperature
B) Higher air temperature
C) Less sunlight
D) More shade
Answer with the letter only.

A plant wilts when it does not get enough:
A) Oxygen from soil
B) Water
C) Carbon from rocks
D) Nitrogen from air alone
Answer with the letter only.

Sound travels fastest through:
A) Vacuum
B) Air
C) Water
D) Steel
Answer with the letter only.

The Moon's phases are caused primarily by:
A) Earth's shadow always covering part of the Moon
B) The Moon's changing distance from Earth
C) The relative positions of the Moon, Earth, and Sun
D) The Moon rotating into different constellations
Answer with the letter only.
choices: Earth's shadow always covering part of the Moon
The Moon's changing distance from Earth
The relative positions of the Moon, Earth, and Sun
The Moon rotating into different constellations
